answer.explanation: My 14:00 note for the dining table on day 5 lists a white wine glass, along with the grey ribbed vase holding a white orchid, the dark grey stone bowl and the gold-and-white placemat. My notes on either side, at 12:00 and 16:00, also list the wine glass, and nothing changed at either patrol.

At 22:00 on day 4 my picture of the island countertop (v113) shows a small orange tapered piece near the yogurt cup. It looks like the carrot piece I noted when it appeared at 20:00 (v097). It is still there at 22:00, next to the sausage on the cutting board, so it looks like a leftover from cooking.

My 20:00 note for the vanity top on day 5 (v111) lists a yellow pump soap bottle. That is hand soap. The same bottle shows up in every note that day, before and after, and none of them records it being moved or taken.

My 16:00 photo of the entryway floor shows a lime-green backpack, a dark brown leather item, a rolled newspaper, a pair of red high-top sneakers and a pair of short black ankle boots. My notes for that patrol also list black ankle boots. Nothing in the picture is clearly a rain boot, so the answer is no. The black pair is small and dark, so it is not fully certain they aren't rubber boots.

I have a note and a picture of the island countertop from 12:00 on day 7. They show a dark woven basket, a milk carton, a gold foil snack bag, a blue yogurt cup, a green glass bowl, a white mug, a white paper bag, a wooden spoon and a red plate. No field notebook appears in the note or the picture.

At 20:00 I photographed the nightstand top. The picture shows a lamp, a white mug, two white chargers with cables, a brown leather case, a lotion bottle, the 'Cool London' book and a green-and-purple case. I saw no phone. The green-and-purple object is a narrow box shaped like a glasses case, which matches my notes from 12:00 onward. A morning note called it 'maybe green phone', but the picture doesn't support that.

In the 16:00 picture there is a small white tube with a red cap lying on the tan tissue box, next to the yellow soap pump. My notes call it a 'white-and-red handheld gadget', but the picture looks like a toothpaste tube. It sat in the same spot all day.

In my 12:00 picture of the desk (v043) I can see the monitor, keyboard, the tablet in its blue case, a dark glass bottle or speaker-like object, a red apple and a mug. There is no water bottle. The clear water bottle with the blue cap was there at 08:00 (v011), was gone by 10:00 (v027), and only came back by 22:00 (v123).
My note for the island countertop at 12:00 on day 5 (v033) lists a yellow banana. Nothing changed there between 10:00 and 12:00, and the banana was also listed at 10:00 (v017) and 14:00 (v049).

My 18:00 note for the countertop by the range lists an olive green glass oil bottle, along with the pepper mill, white bowl and crisps bag. The bottle first showed up there at 14:00 and was still listed at 16:00, 20:00 and 22:00.

My 14:00 note for the bathroom 2 floor (v064) lists a black toiletry bag with a brass zipper pull. The picture I kept shows a small black boxy zippered bag with an orange-brass pull near the back of the floor. It sits beside the jeans, the reading glasses, the socks and the camouflage trousers.

At 14:00 on day 6 my picture of the vanity top shows a wooden tissue box, a small white-and-red handheld gadget on top of it, a yellow pump soap bottle, toilet paper rolls and a blue item behind. There is no toothpaste. At 22:00 the same white-and-red object is seen from another angle and is clearly a gadget with a nozzle, not a toothpaste tube.

At 16:00 on day 3 the picture of the bathroom 2 floor shows a dark red plaid knit sock lying near the jeans and the black bag. It looks like a wool sock. The jeans, thin glasses, black bag, teal towel and white cloth are also there.

At 10:00 the countertop by the range held a green oil bottle, a pepper mill, a white bowl with a wooden spoon and a crisps bag. The only spatula there was the one with a black handle and a grey, metal-looking slotted head, which my notes call a steel slotted spatula. I saw no silicone spatula there.

My 20:00 picture of the countertop by the range (v101) shows a crisps bag, a silver foil bag, a black knife, a cutting board with a white crumpled cloth, a carrot or chili, a wooden spoon, a small white bowl and a pan. There is no spatula of any kind. The only spatula I had noted, a black-handled steel slotted one, was already gone by 18:00 (v085).
My 18:00 note for the countertop beside the kitchen sink on day 4 lists a tall black thermos. The same thermos is in my notes for this spot at 16:00 and at 20:00, where it had been moved.
My 08:00 note for the dining table on day 5 lists a white wine glass on the table. It had been moved within the table since the last patrol. A wine glass is always on this table.

At 22:00 my notes didn't list the green oil bottle, but they said at 20:00 it was probably just hidden. In the 22:00 picture (v117), a white cloth or bag covers the cutting board. The bottle's black cap and tan neck band still stick up behind it, in the same spot as the green olive oil bottle in the 18:00 picture (v085). So the oil bottle was still there, mostly hidden.

My 12:00 note and picture of the left cooktop show a black low casserole pan, a small dark grey canister, a large brown egg, a small blue kettle behind the egg, a dark pan at the far back right and the snack bag. The long-handled steel saucepan wasn't there yet. My notes first record it at 14:00, marked as newly appeared. I can't fully rule out that the partly hidden dark pan at the back right is a small saucepan.

At 08:00 on day 4 there was a pair of dark grey soft trousers lying at the bottom-left of the bedroom 1 floor, and the picture shows them. They look like lounge pants. A second dark grey folded cloth, possibly another pair, was near the doorway. A silver ballet flat was also on the floor.

My 12:00 note (v036) and its picture show the left cooktop with a snack bag, a white crumpled cloth or bag, an orange-red sausage, a small blue kettle and a paper towel roll. I can't see a ladle in the picture, and none is listed in the note.
At 08:00 on day 3, my note for the office desk top (v011) lists a clear water bottle with a blue cap, along with the monitor, keyboard, mouse and tablet. By 10:00 the bottle was gone (v027).

In my 10:00 picture of the bathroom 2 floor (v032), a white t-shirt lies over a pair of black bottoms. They look like sleepwear, so I count them as sleep pants, though they could also be shorts. They were not there at 08:00 (v016). They appeared at 10:00 along with the morning change of clothes.

In my 18:00 picture of the desk, there are small white paper slips with printed marks on the front of the desk, left of the notebook. They look like receipts. These are the same 'small white scraps' that first showed up at 12:00 (v043). They were still there at 18:00, along with the notebook, the tan folder, the keyboard and the monitor.

My note for the dining table at 08:00 on day 3 (v008) lists a white wine glass on the white round marble tabletop. My notes say the glass is always on this table, and later visits show it too (v024, v040).

My 14:00 picture of the countertop by the range on day 7 shows only a green oil bottle, a small white bowl with a wooden spoon, a wooden pepper mill, a crisps bag and a steel spatula. There were no canned tomatoes there.

At 08:00 on day 5, my picture of the countertop by the range shows a wooden pepper mill, a tilted white round bowl and a yellow-and-white crisps bag. There is no wooden spoon. My note for that patrol lists the same three items.

At 08:00 on day 6 I have a picture of the bedroom 1 floor. It shows dark grey trousers, a potted tree, curtains and a white floor, with the next room visible through the doorway. There are no kitchen clogs in the picture.

My 10:00 picture of the office desk on day 3 shows the monitor, a white keyboard, a white tablet in a blue cover, a dark glass bottle, a red apple and a white printed mug. I can't see a wallet in it, and my note for that visit doesn't list one either.

At 18:00 on day 7 my picture of the bedroom 1 floor shows only the white carpet, the tall potted tree, the curtain and the grey wall panels, plus the living room through the doorway. There were no lounge pants or any other clothes on the floor. My note for that time says the same, and the floor stayed empty all of day 7.

At 12:00 the island still had the black flat case. My note calls it a 'black flat case', but in the 08:00 and 12:00 pictures it looks like a closed black notebook lying flat behind the banana, and an orange pencil sat next to it at 08:00. That fits a field notebook. It is not a confident identification: the item is small and partly hidden.

At 10:00 the countertop beside the sink had a tall black thermos, an orange detergent bottle, a brown bowl, a rolled towel, a crumpled bag, a black-lidded container and a blue-and-white dish in the sink. There was no water bottle. A blue-and-white plastic water bottle first showed up at 12:00.

At 16:00 my picture of the left cooktop shows a small yellow-and-white item behind the green bottle, next to the black pan and the new blue kettle. It was not there at 14:00, when only the white candle stood in that spot. It is still there at 18:00 and is gone by 22:00. It is small and partly hidden, but its shape and colour fit the head of a silicone spatula left after cooking. I can't be fully sure it is a spatula.

My 14:00 picture of the dining table shows a white stemmed wine glass, a grey ribbed vase with a white orchid, a dark grey stone bowl, a gold-and-white flat runner or book, and papers at the far edge. There is no water glass or tumbler. The only glass is the stemmed wine glass that is always on this table.

My 18:00 note for the sink basin lists a blue-and-white bottle, a tall black bottle, a paper towel roll, a beige rolled towel, an orange Ace detergent bottle, a white plate and the faucet. It lists no mug. The picture I kept matches the note, and no mug is visible.

At 14:00 on day 4 I photographed the bathroom 2 floor (v064). It showed light blue jeans, thin black reading glasses, two white socks, camouflage trousers, a plaid sock, a black bag with a brass pull, a white shirt and a beige hanging towel. The white piece at the bottom edge is cut off by the frame, but it looks like a shirt with sleeves. I saw no dress.

My 08:00 picture of the island countertop on day 7 shows a large black box-like case, a gold foil snack bag, a small white cup at the left edge and a few small orange and white bits. I see no olive oil bottle. The black case blocks part of the counter, but no oil bottle shows anywhere in the frame.

My 08:00 picture of the dining table on day 6 shows a white wine glass, a dark stone bowl, an orchid in a grey ribbed pot, a white plate with a blue rim and a gold-and-white tray. Behind the bowl there is also a small, flat, clear glass piece. None of these is a honey jar, and the notes for that patrol list no jar.

At 18:00 on day 7 my note for the island countertop says it was bare, and the picture I kept shows the same. Only the snake plant in its pot is behind the counter. I see no menu folder or any other folder there.

My 16:00 picture of the island shows a mug, a basket with towels, a plate, a bowl, a brown egg, an oil bottle, a yogurt cup, a banana, a snack bag, a dark brown curved object and a small orange pencil. There are no carrots. The small orange item on the right is the pencil, with its tip showing, and the orange round item behind the bowl is the brown egg.

At 22:00 on day 6 my picture of the left cooktop shows a steel saucepan, a black low casserole pan, a tall black stockpot, a white round bowl and the green oil bottle. There are no carrots in the picture or in my note for that patrol.

I have a picture of the left cooktop from 14:00 on day 3 (v052). It shows the black gas range with red knobs, an olive green bottle, a black frying pan, a small white cylinder (probably a candle) behind the bottle, and a white bowl on the counter. I don't see anything that looks like a can of tomatoes, such as a red-labelled can.

My 20:00 picture of this counter shows a black thermos, an orange detergent bottle, a rolled cream towel, crumpled white plastic bags and one flat white plate in the sink. There is no bowl in it. The brown patterned bowl that is usually here was gone by 10:00 and was not seen again that day.

My 10:00 day-5 note for the island countertop lists the basket with towels, a brown bowl, a green-rimmed plate, a snack bag, a white bottle, a banana, the oil bottle, an egg, a mug and a yogurt cup. There is no notebook in that list, and the picture I kept from that patrol doesn't show one either.

My 12:00 picture of the nightstand (v044) shows the lamp, a white mug, the chargers, a brown leather case, a lotion bottle, the 'Cool London' book and a green-and-purple case. There are no keys in it. At 08:00 (v012) a black key fob with a red tag was on the left front edge. It had been taken away by 12:00, even though the note at 12:00 says 'no change'.

At 20:00 on day 6 I photographed the entryway floor. The picture shows black ankle boots, a rolled newspaper, red high-top sneakers, a small brown item near the armchair, the coat rack and the armchair. There is no jacket on the floor or on the coat rack.

At 20:00 on day 6 my note for this countertop lists a tall black thermos, and the kept picture shows a tall black insulated bottle standing on the counter by the sink. My other note for this sink calls it a tall black cylindrical bottle. I am counting this drink bottle as the water bottle, so the answer is yes.

My 10:00 picture of the bedroom 1 floor shows only one item of clothing: a dark grey garment that looks like a pair of trousers lying on the floor. There is no cardigan. The rest of the picture is the potted tree and the room beyond the doorway.

My 12:00 picture of the dining table (v040) shows one white stemmed wine glass, the orchid in a grey ribbed pot, a dark grey stone bowl, a gold-and-white runner and papers. There is no water glass or tumbler. The only glass is the stemmed wine glass that is always on this table.

The banana was on the island at 10:00 (v017) and was gone by 12:00 (v033). My 16:00 picture (v065) shows the milk carton, a snack bag, a water bottle, a cutting board and the basket of towels. There is no banana in it.

The only book on the bed is a dark navy book; my notes call it a hardcover, but the picture shows a thin book that could be a paperback. It was on the duvet in every patrol picture from 08:00 to 20:00. At 22:00 it was gone. So it was taken between 20:00 and 22:00.

At 08:00 my note for the left cooktop lists an olive green oil bottle there (v004). At 10:00 the note says the olive green oil bottle is gone, and two lidded black pots are on the burners instead (v020). The oil was not on the cooktop at any later patrol, so it was taken off between 08:00 and 10:00.

There is no thin grey utensil on the counter in the 20:00 picture. In the 22:00 picture, a thin grey spoon-like utensil is on the counter edge to the left of the sink. My notes for both the sink-side countertop and the sink basin also record it as new at 22:00. So it was put there between 20:00 and 22:00.

In the 18:00 picture (v083), a white plate is in the sink and a round white plate hangs above it. In the 20:00 picture (v099), both plates are gone and a 'Grandpa' mug sits where the plate was. The plate was there at every patrol from 10:00 to 18:00, so it was taken between 18:00 and 20:00.

In the 08:00 picture (v001) a laptop stands open on the island; you can see the back of its lid and the keyboard base. My note called it a 'black case'. By 10:00 (v017) it is gone and breakfast things have taken its place. It does not show up on the island in the later pictures I opened (v049, v065), so it was taken between 08:00 and 10:00.

My notes show the brown egg on the island countertop at every patrol from 08:00 through 18:00 (v081 still lists it). At 20:00 (v097) the note says 'brown egg gone', and at the same time a large brown egg appeared on the left cooktop (v100). It was still missing from the island at 22:00 (v113).

The flat white slip of paper on the island counter, most likely the receipt, shows in the 10:00 picture (white bits at right) and the 12:00 picture (white paper strips in the middle of the counter). It is gone in the 14:00 picture, so it was taken between 12:00 and 14:00.

My 20:00 picture of the left cooktop (v100) shows no egg on the range. My 22:00 picture (v116) shows a large brown egg on the range beside the green bottle. Earlier notes for this spot (v004–v084) never list an egg. So the egg was put there between 20:00 and 22:00.

My notes call the ribbed cup on the coffee table a 'cream ribbed paper cup', and it is the water glass. In the 18:00 picture it stands in the middle of the table. In the 20:00 picture it is gone and everything else is still there. Note v102 also records it as gone at 20:00.

My 18:00 note on the left cooktop (v084) lists empty grates, a paper bag, an orange item, the kettle and a snack bag, with no egg. My 20:00 note (v100) records that a large brown egg appeared, along with the casserole pan and a small pot. The egg was still there at 22:00 (v116).

My notes list the large brown egg on the countertop by the range at every patrol from 08:00 through 20:00 (v101). At 22:00 (v117) the note records 'large brown egg gone', so it was taken between 20:00 and 22:00.

In the 08:00 picture, the black key fob with a red tag is on the nightstand. In the 10:00 picture it is gone, while the mug, wallet, chargers, lotion bottle, London book and green-and-purple case are all still there. That means the keys were taken between 08:00 and 10:00. The fob is also missing from the notes at every later patrol.

The 08:00 picture of the island countertop (v001) shows no olive-green oil bottle. By the 10:00 patrol (v017) an olive-green glass bottle with a black stopper had appeared. It was still there in every later patrol that day.

I don't remember any shirt being taken off the bathroom 2 floor on day 5. The only shirt there is a white T-shirt, and it is in the same spot in my 08:00, 14:00, 16:00, 18:00 and 22:00 pictures. Nothing on it marks it as a restaurant shirt. What changed that day was the grey-green towel, which went between 14:00 and 16:00, and the white socks. Since no shirt removal shows up, I can't give a time.

The pictures of this counter at 12:00, 14:00 and 18:00 show only the pepper mill, white bowl, oil bottle and crisps bag. There is no utensil on the counter. At 20:00 a long, thin black utensil lies on the left of the counter. My note called it a knife, but it is most likely the black silicone spatula. It is still there at 22:00. So it was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

In the 14:00 picture of the countertop beside the kitchen sink, there is no thermos. Only the orange detergent bottle, the brown bowl, the faucet and the dish rack are there. In the 16:00 picture, a tall black thermos stands next to the sink. So it was put there between 14:00 and 16:00.

In the 18:00 picture (v091), the desk has no laptop. By 20:00 (v107), a small white-silver open laptop is on the left side of the desk, along with a black case and a small gold item. It was put there in the evening, probably by Mara.

My notes for the countertop by the range list no egg at 08:00, 10:00, 12:00, 14:00, 16:00 or 18:00 (v005, v021, v037, v053, v069, v085). At 20:00 (v101) the large brown egg appeared, and it was still there at 22:00 (v117). So it was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.

The 18:00 picture of the bathroom 2 floor (v096) has no dress. The 20:00 picture (v112) shows a black-and-white dress on the floor, and it is still there at 22:00 (v128). So the dress was put down between 18:00 and 20:00.

My 08:00 picture of the island countertop shows no egg: only the basket, bottle, banana, plate, yogurt cup and other small items. In my 10:00 picture a large brown egg is in the front of the counter. It stays there in every later patrol that day, so it was put there between 08:00 and 10:00.

At 08:00 the bedroom 1 floor had two dark garments: one at the bottom left and a folded one near the doorway. There was also a silver flat. By 10:00 only one dark garment was left, a trouser-like piece in the middle. That piece stayed until it was cleared between 20:00 and 22:00. The other dark garment disappeared between 08:00 and 10:00, and I take it to be the sleep shirt. The pictures don't clearly show which dark garment was the shirt, so this is my best reading.

In the 10:00 picture (v032), a grey hoodie is lying on the bathroom 2 floor at the lower left. My 12:00 note (v048) had no description, so I opened that picture. The hoodie is gone in it, and it is also missing from the 14:00 picture (v064). So it was taken between 10:00 and 12:00.

The 14:00 picture of the bathroom 2 floor (v064) has no hoodie in it. The 16:00 picture (v080) shows a grey hoodie on the floor, along with a second pair of camouflage trousers. So the hoodie was put down between 14:00 and 16:00.

In the 16:00 picture, the coffee table has only the paper cup, photo book, record saucer, mug and stone bowl. There is no tin. The 18:00 picture shows a small brown vintage tin, which I take to be the tea tin. It stayed on the table at 20:00 and 22:00.

The 08:00 picture shows the steel saucepan with its long handle on the burners. In the 10:00 picture it's gone, and a black casserole pan, an egg and a small bowl are there instead. A saucepan was back on the range at 18:00 and still there at 22:00, so the only time it was taken off on day 7 was between 08:00 and 10:00.

At 08:00 the brown patterned bowl was on the countertop beside the sink (v003). At 10:00 my note says it was gone (v019). The same bowl turned up on the kitchen island at 10:00 (v017). My notes were enough, so I opened no pictures.

None of my notes or pictures of the sink basin on day 4 show a cast iron skillet. The 08:00, 10:00, 20:00 and 22:00 pictures show a mug, the coffee tin, the brown patterned bowl, the black bottle and the detergent, but no skillet. From this angle the bottom of the deep basin is hidden, so a skillet could be down there unseen. I can't tell when one was put there.

At 16:00 my note for the countertop by the range (v069) lists the oil bottle, bowl with spoon, pepper mill, crisps bag and spatula, but no carrot. At 18:00 (v085) a wooden cutting board with an orange carrot had appeared there, along with knives and a spoon. So the carrot was put there between 16:00 and 18:00.

In the 18:00 picture the sink basin is empty: there are bottles, a paper towel roll, a towel and a plate, but no pan. By 20:00 a black round pan (saucepan) is sitting in the basin, and it is still there at 22:00. So it was put there between 18:00 and 20:00.
My 12:00 note for the left cooktop (v036) lists the brown egg on the edge of the cooktop. My 14:00 note (v052) says the brown egg is gone, and a saucepan and a stockpot were put on the stove instead.

answer.doing: Starting to make dinner: she set out a cutting board, cut a carrot, and left knives, a wooden spoon and a pan on the range, then left the prep part-done.
answer.explanation: Nothing changed here at 16:00, so this happened between 16:00 and 18:00. Julian normally leaves for the restaurant around 16:30 and Mara gets home around 17:30. At 18:00 there are other signs of her coming home: the boots and sneakers in the entryway were nudged and the island was cleared. The same cooking carried on into the evening, with a pan in the sink at 20:00 and dishes on the dining table, while Julian was at work. Julian cooks a lot, so it could have been him, but the evening timing points to Mara.

answer.doing: Clearing breakfast and getting ready to cook: the plate of white food and the pencil were taken away, and a brown egg and the olive-green oil bottle (moved from the cooktop) were put out on the island.
answer.explanation: Between 08:00 and 10:00 the breakfast plate went and an egg and oil bottle appeared. At the same time two lidded pots were put on the stove and the oil bottle left the cooktop, so someone was cooking. Julian cooks a lot at home and leaves around 09:30. Mara usually leaves around 08:30, so most of this window fits Julian. I didn't see anyone, so this is a likely guess, not certain.

answer.doing: Having an evening meal or drinks at the dining table: two white cups, a white plate and a black spoon were set out, the wine glass was moved and the small white jar was taken out of the wooden bowl.
answer.explanation: Between 18:00 and 20:00, two cups, a plate and a spoon appeared on the table and the wine glass moved, which looks like a meal. Food was being made in the kitchen at the same time: a carrot was cut by the range at 18:00, and pans were put in the sink by 20:00. Julian is usually at the restaurant from 16:30 to 23:30, and Mara gets home around 17:30, so it was probably Mara. Nobody was seen.

answer.doing: Changing clothes on an afternoon break: dropped a grey hoodie and a second pair of camouflage trousers, took the white sneaker and orange boot, and moved the towel, bag, jeans and reading glasses.
answer.explanation: Between 14:00 (v064) and 16:00 (v080), a hoodie and trousers appeared, shoes were taken, and other clothes were moved. That looks like someone changing before going out again. It fits Julian's break between shifts (about 14:30-16:30). Mara is usually at her studio until 17:30. The same window shows home activity elsewhere (coffee table v070, island v065). This floor is mostly his clothes and changes in his time slots.

answer.doing: Having breakfast at the island. Milk, a yogurt cup, a banana, a green glass bowl and snack bags were set out and left there. The dark basket was moved, and the black thing seen at 08:00 is no longer there.
answer.explanation: Between 08:00 and 10:00, breakfast food appeared on the island while the range and the counter beside it were used for cooking. The egg was used, the knife and bowl were taken and a spatula was left out. Julian cooks a lot at home and is usually home until about 09:30. Mara leaves around 08:30. So this was most likely Julian, but no picture shows who did it.

answer.doing: Someone cooked a midday meal. They took the egg off the cooktop and put a steel saucepan and a tall black stockpot on the burners, with a frying pan and oil next to the range. The leftover dishes and food went into the sink.
answer.explanation: At 12:00 the cooktop had the egg, the canister and the blue kettle. By 14:00 those were gone and a saucepan and stockpot were on it. At the same time a frying pan and oil bottle appeared by the range, the egg was moved to the island, and a plate of food went into the sink. Julian cooks a lot, but his schedule puts him at the restaurant then, and Mara should be at her studio. None of their things show up here.

answer.doing: Someone changed clothes or sorted the pile on the bathroom floor. The camouflage trousers, one white shirt, the black shoe and a white sock were picked up. Orange-and-black strapped trousers were dropped, and the black boxy bag was moved to the back.
answer.explanation: In v112 vs v128 the camo trousers, top-right shirt, black shoe and bottom sock are gone, orange strapped trousers appear and the bag moved. Julian is normally at the restaurant from 16:30 to 23:30. Mara was clearly home this evening: her tan wallet appeared on the nightstand by 22:00 and the kitchen and dining table were used. So this was probably Mara, though no one was seen and the clothes may be Julian's.

answer.doing: Someone had an evening hot drink or coffee, then tidied up. They put away the coffee tin and canister, cleared the plates, left the used 'Grandpa' mug in the sink, moved the thermos and left crumpled paper towels behind.
answer.explanation: At 18:00 the coffee tin, canister and plates were on the counter. By 20:00 they were gone and the 'Grandpa' mug sat in the sink. The blue kettle also turned up on the range in the same window. A red handbag and sneakers arrived by 18:00, which fits Mara coming home at about 17:30. Julian is usually at the restaurant from 16:30 to 23:30. The Grandpa mug was on the office desk in the morning and left the desk when Mara probably did.

answer.doing: Someone cleared the table and set a new dish there around midday: they took away the blue-rimmed plate, put down a brown wooden bowl holding a small white lidded jar, and moved the wine glass a little. It looks like a light meal or a snack being put out, or dishes being swapped.
answer.explanation: The 12:00 and 14:00 pictures show the blue-rimmed plate gone, a wooden bowl with a small white jar added, and the wine glass shifted. The kitchen island, sink, desk and sideboard also changed at midday, so someone was home. But Mara is usually at her studio and Julian at the restaurant until about 14:30. Nothing left on the table belongs to either of them, so I can't say who it was.

answer.doing: Had a short break at the coffee table between restaurant shifts. Cleared the second white mug and the brown tin box, moved the cup, saucer, photo book and stone bowl, and left a small cream card or note.
answer.explanation: This happened between 14:00 and 16:00. Mara is normally at her studio until about 17:30, and Julian is usually home from about 14:30 to 16:30. Other changes in the same window also point to him: the black phone was taken from the nightstand, a brown leather item appeared at the entryway, and a small dark item was left on the piano shelf. Earlier changes to this table in the morning and on breaks also fit Julian.

answer.doing: Probably making a midday lunch. The breakfast leftovers (green bowl, white mug, wooden spoon, paper bag) were cleared away, a black lidded pot was put on the wooden cutting board, and the milk, yogurt and basket were pushed aside.
answer.explanation: Both residents are normally out at midday, so this is an inference, not something I saw. Julian is usually at the restaurant until about 14:30. The same 10:00–14:00 window also shows desk work in the office (v043, v059) and the red coaster on the sideboard (v055), which I think is Mara's.
